articles.title: AI trade loses steam as infrastructure boom faces reality check
articles.snippet: Record earnings, rising competition and concerns over slowing AI spending are forcing investors to reassess one of the market's biggest trades.

articles.title: The 5 types of real world assets being tokenized fastest onchain
articles.snippet: Tokenized Real World Assets span treasuries, real estate, stocks, commodities and private credit. The sector is still small in TradFi terms but it's growing very, very fast.
